Hallo ﻿Lara Anna Oblak,
Thanks for the reply.
As checked in logs for the specific time interval as per the shared screenshot.
The session is getting stopped because Ecog LE controller for
DC1
Ip address (10.11.20.101) is not accessible
Last successful session on DC1 was
2025-03-27, 20:51:57
2025-03-27T20:52:00.082540+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:err] ecog-error-reporting-proxy/6144f33c45ce[640]: 2025/03/27 20:52:00 [error] 22#22: *59 connect() to [2600:9000:262a:8200:5:e77e:65c0:93a1]:443 failed (101: Network unreachable) while connecting to upstream, client: 10.20.17.101, server: , request: "POST /log-upload HTTP/1.1", upstream: "https://[2600:9000:262a:8200:5:e77e:65c0:93a1]:443/v1/log-upload", host: "10.20.17.14:8444"
After that there was continuous issue with Ecog LE observed for which session is interrupting every time.
Suspected root cause:
1) Ethernet cable from Ecog LE may be loose
2) Fault in Ecog LE(KF12)
3) Ecog LE in Error state as per Log
2025-03-27T21:02:02.097691+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/6bd623b1f1d0[640]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (08d27539-c3aa-4a38-be72-8eb8bd6cd835) - {"connectorId":1,"errorCode":"OtherError","status":"Faulted","vendorId":"SICHARGE D","vendorErrorCode":"s
ecc pilot is E"}
Solution:
1) Reboot the charger once & check if Outlet 1 is working or not by trying charging session:
please let us know the status
(Currently charging session is going on in DC2)
2) I will be requesting for SSH access for the charger to check if Ecog LE Ip address is accessible or not
3) If Ip address not accessible i will inform region to check the Charger with required Spare parts
With best regards,
